anthropic.title: Version 1.30.0 of the `ant` CLI adds `ant apply`
anthropic.summary: ant CLI新增资源即代码命令，可从仓库文件创建和更新资源。

anthropic.title: We've launched **Claude Fable 5.1** (`claude-fable-5-1`), the successor to Claude Fable 5 for long-running agentic coding, knowledge work, and research, alongside **Claude Mythos 5.1** (`claude-mythos-5-1`) for Project Glasswing participants.
anthropic.summary: 发布Fable 5.1与Mythos 5.1，支持百万上下文和128k输出。

anthropic.title: Prompt cache reads on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $0.25 USD per million tokens
anthropic.summary: 两款5.1模型的提示缓存读取价降至每百万词元0.25美元。

anthropic.title: On Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, `tool_choice` types `any` and `tool` aren't supported and return a 400 error.
anthropic.summary: 两款5.1模型不支持tool_choice的any与tool类型。

anthropic.title: Thinking blocks produced by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are preserved only for the model that produced them or a newer one
anthropic.summary: 5.1模型思考块仅可由原模型或更新模型保留和读取。

anthropic.title: Per-message effort changes are in beta on Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, and Claude Opus 5 on the Claude API.
anthropic.summary: Claude API测试按消息调整努力等级，并可保留提示缓存。

anthropic.title: Turn-scoped system messages are in beta
anthropic.summary: 回合级系统消息进入测试，仅在当前回合生效且不增加词元成本。

anthropic.title: `thinking.display` accepts a third value, `"updates"`, in beta
anthropic.summary: thinking.display测试新增updates值，可返回工具调用间进度。

anthropic.title: Text generated by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 carries Anthropic's text watermark
anthropic.summary: 5.1模型文本带水印，生成媒体可附C2PA内容凭证。

anthropic.title: Like Claude Fable 5, both models require 30-day data retention and aren't available under zero data retention unless expressly authorized by Anthropic.
anthropic.summary: 两款5.1模型要求保留数据30天，默认不支持零数据保留。

anthropic.title: The guides for the Claude Enterprise endpoints of the Admin API, the Claude Enterprise Analytics API, and the Compliance API now show the `anthropic-version` header
anthropic.summary: 企业管理、分析及合规端点现要求每次请求发送版本标头。

anthropic.title: In Python SDK 1.2.0, TypeScript SDK 0.122.0, Go SDK 1.68.0, Java SDK 2.59.0, Ruby SDK 1.67.0, and C# SDK 12.44.0, `client.beta.files` and `client.beta.skills` no longer send the `files-api-2025-04-14` and `skills-2025-10-02` beta headers and return the same shapes as `client.files` and `client.skills`.
anthropic.summary: 多语言SDK停止为Files与Skills接口自动发送旧测试标头。

openai.title: Released GPT-6 Astra
openai.summary: 发布面向复杂端到端任务的旗舰模型GPT-6 Astra。

openai.title: Added new controls for long-running work with GPT-6 Astra in the Responses API
openai.summary: Responses API新增异步工具调用、中途引导及推理强度调整。

openai.title: Updated API errors so applications can distinguish traffic that increases too quickly from temporary model overload.
openai.summary: 更新API错误码，以区分流量增长过快与模型临时过载。

openai.title: Mutual TLS (mTLS) and X.509 workload identity federation are now generally available for the OpenAI API.
openai.summary: OpenAI API正式支持mTLS和X.509工作负载身份联合。

openai.title: Announced the deprecation of `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`.
openai.summary: 多款转录模型将于2027年2月26日停用，Assistants API亦已关闭。

openai.title: API customers can now select regional processing for an individual request by using a prefixed domain with an API key from a project having Global geography.
openai.summary: API客户现可按单个请求选择区域处理。

openai.title: GPT-5.6 Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens
openai.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol输入价降20%，输出价降33%。

openai.title: Released the Prompt Caching dashboard on the OpenAI API platform.
openai.summary: 上线提示缓存仪表板，可分析命中率及缓存令牌使用情况。
